notes.title: 🎮 Release 2.0: Major Update
notes.content:
[list]

[*] [h3]🤖 [b]AI Completely Redesigned[/b][/h3]: Improved behavior.

[*] [h3]🏆 [b]Achievements Added[/b][/h3]

[*] [h3]🕴 [b]Slenderman Updated[/b][/h3]: Redesigned visuals and animations.

[*] [h3]📱 [b]Phone Removed[/b][/h3]: Phone mechanic removed.

[*] [h3]🔦 [b]Flashlight Added[/b][/h3]: Illuminates dark areas.

[*] [h3]🗺 [b]Manual Map Added[/b][/h3]

[*] [h3]🐞 [b]Bugs Fixed[/b][/h3]: Increased stability.

[*] [h3]⚙ [b]Map Optimization[/b][/h3]

[*] [h3]🛠 [b]Settings Updated[/b][/h3]

[*] [h3]🎨 [b]Post-Processing[/b][/h3]: Visual enhancements.

[*] [h3]💀 [b]New Deaths[/b][/h3]: Different death scenarios.
[/list]

[i]Found a bug? Report it on Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/PH625kue4t]https://discord.gg/PH625kue4t[/url][/i]

notes.title: 📢 Update 1.0.3 is live!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the release of Version 1.0.3 with new features and improvements:

🛠[b] What’s New?[/b]

🌟 FOV Adjustment: Customize your Field of View for a more comfortable experience!
⚙️ Max FPS Setting: Set a cap for your frame rate to optimize performance.
🚀 Minor Optimizations: Improved overall game stability and performance.
🕵️ Slenderman Behavior Fixes: Adjustments to improve gameplay dynamics.


📩 Found a bug?
Let us know on our Discord server! Your feedback helps us make the game even better.

Thank you for your support! 💜
